nodes.title: Repository bootstrap: packaging, tooling, CI, secret hygiene

acceptance_criteria.statement: Editable install succeeds and exposes the redgear command.
Strict type checking and linting both execute with zero configuration errors.
CI workflow runs lint, types, tests, and the egress grep gates on push.
Secret scanning pre-commit hook is installed and passes on a clean tree.

nodes.note: SCAFFOLD type: verified by smoke checks, coverage gate disabled. Two-phase TDD does not apply to packaging metadata.

nodes.title: Write failing tests: schemas.py — every Pydantic model

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every model round-trips through JSON without loss or coercion drift.
Models reject unknown fields and are immutable where declared frozen.
The event union discriminates correctly on the event field for every type.
An implementation node carrying its own acceptance criteria fails validation.

nodes.note: schemas.py is a leaf module and must import nothing else from the package.

nodes.title: Implement: schemas.py — every Pydantic model
Write failing tests: errors.py and paths.py — error codes and glob resolution

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every documented error code maps to a distinct exception subclass.
Recursive glob matching handles nested paths and never matches absolute paths.
Overlapping writable and frozen globs are detected over a tracked file list.

nodes.title: Implement: errors.py and paths.py — error codes and glob resolution
Write failing tests: hashing.py — canonical JSON and content addressing

acceptance_criteria.statement: Canonical encoding is byte-stable across process restarts and key reordering.
Reordering the requirements list does not change the specification hash.
Changing a requirement statement does change the specification hash.
Metadata fields are excluded from the hashed payload.
File digests are stable and detect single-byte modifications.

nodes.note: Determinism here is load-bearing. If the hash drifts, every downstream guarantee is theatre.

nodes.title: Implement: hashing.py — canonical JSON and content addressing
Write failing tests: redact.py — credential redaction for logs and events

acceptance_criteria.statement: Variables whose names match credential patterns are redacted from mappings.
A known secret value appearing in free text is replaced before emission.
Redaction is idempotent and never corrupts non-secret content.

nodes.title: Implement: redact.py — credential redaction for logs and events
Write failing tests: events.py — append-only log with gapless sequencing

acceptance_criteria.statement: Appending assigns strictly monotonic gapless sequence numbers under repeated writes.
Every event type parses back from a written line without loss.
A gap or repeated sequence number is reported as corruption and never repaired.
Appends are flushed to disk before the call returns.

nodes.title: Implement: events.py — append-only log with gapless sequencing
Write failing tests: state_engine.py read path — load, validate, project

acceptance_criteria.statement: Replaying the log reproduces a known task graph byte-identically.
A cycle in the edge set is rejected and the offending cycle is named.
Readiness is computed as all hard dependencies verified, recomputed per load.
An implementation node without an inherited criteria source fails validation.
Task selection prefers nodes on the critical path by descending dependency count.

nodes.title: Implement: state_engine.py read path — load, validate, project
Write failing tests: state_engine.py write path — transitions and atomic persistence

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every state transition appends exactly one event.
Claiming records the base commit and a digest for every frozen file.
Projection writes are atomic and never observable in a partial state.
An illegal transition for the current state is rejected with a state error.
A blocked outcome escalates the task without incrementing the attempt counter.

nodes.title: Implement: state_engine.py write path — transitions and atomic persistence
Write failing tests: locks.py — exclusive task leases and single-run lock

acceptance_criteria.statement: Concurrent claims on one task result in exactly one winner.
An expired lease is reaped and the task returns to a claimable state.
A second run in the same repository is refused while a run lock is held.
No termination path leaves an orphaned lock file behind.

nodes.title: Implement: locks.py — exclusive task leases and single-run lock
Write failing tests: budget.py — autonomy caps, stop sentinel, signal handling

acceptance_criteria.statement: Iteration, wall clock, and consecutive failure caps each terminate the run cleanly.
Caps are evaluated before an iteration begins and never mid-turn.
Presence of the stop sentinel ends the run at the next boundary with success status.
Interrupt signals abort the turn, terminate the process tree, and release locks.

nodes.title: Implement: budget.py — autonomy caps, stop sentinel, signal handling
Write failing tests: gitctx.py — read-only git interrogation and diff parsing

acceptance_criteria.statement: The changed set is correct for modified, added, deleted, and untracked files.
Untracked files appear in the diff via intent-to-add without creating a commit.
Changed line numbers are parsed from zero-context hunks with no inflation.
A dirty working tree is detected and reported with the offending paths.
No operation mutates repository history or creates a commit.

nodes.note: Runs against a real git fixture repository. Do not mock subprocess here.

nodes.title: Implement: gitctx.py — read-only git interrogation and diff parsing
Write failing tests: verifier.py gates 1-2 — scope and frozen hash audit

acceptance_criteria.statement: A write outside the writable scope fails the scope gate naming every offending path.
A file changed but not declared by the agent fails as an undeclared change.
A file declared but never touched fails as a phantom change.
Modification, deletion, or addition inside a frozen glob each fail distinctly.
Every frozen violation is reported, not only the first.
Gates after a failure are recorded as skipped rather than omitted.

nodes.title: Implement: verifier.py gates 1-2 — scope and frozen hash audit
Write failing tests: verifier.py gates 3-6 — lint, tests, criteria, coverage delta

acceptance_criteria.statement: A lint violation inside scope fails the gate and the test suite never runs.
A pre-existing violation outside the task scope does not fail the gate.
A collection error is reported distinctly from an assertion failure.
For a test authoring task the gate passes only when target tests fail.
A criterion citing a nonexistent test node fails as evidence not found.
Coverage is computed over changed lines only and matches a hand-computed ratio.
A command exceeding its timeout is a recorded gate failure, not an exception.
Nested runner invocation is isolated from the outer session cache and root directory.

nodes.note: TRAP: this gate runs pytest and coverage inside a fixture repo while itself under pytest. The inner invocation must disable the cache provider, pin an explicit root directory, and scrub PYTEST_* from the environment, or it inherits the outer configuration.

nodes.title: Implement: verifier.py gates 3-6 — lint, tests, criteria, coverage delta
Write failing tests: runner protocol and deterministic fake runner

acceptance_criteria.statement: The fake runner satisfies the protocol and applies canned changes without a subprocess.
Each declared agent behaviour scenario produces its documented outcome.
No test path spawns a real agent process or opens a network connection.

nodes.note: The fake lives under tests/ and is written by the test_authoring task. The implementation task writes only the protocol in the package.

nodes.title: Implement: runner protocol and deterministic fake runner
Write failing tests: prompt_engine.py — deterministic prompt composition

acceptance_criteria.statement: Composing twice from identical state yields byte-identical output.
Section order is fixed and empty sections render explicitly rather than vanishing.
Frozen paths and the outcome contract appear in every task prompt.
A retry prompt contains the formatted failure excerpt from the prior attempt.
Untrusted content sits inside delimiters and embedded markers are escaped.
Terminal escapes are stripped and absolute paths rewritten as repository relative.
Total prompt length never exceeds the configured character cap.
Golden snapshots exist for first attempt, retry, both task types, and multi-rule cases.

nodes.note: HIGHEST RISK MODULE. Failures here are silent — a worse prompt only lowers the success rate. Snapshots are mandatory, not optional.

nodes.title: Implement: prompt_engine.py — deterministic prompt composition
Write failing tests: orchestrator.py — the continuous execution loop

acceptance_criteria.statement: A verified task advances the graph and the next ready task is selected immediately.
A failed task is re-selected and its retry prompt carries the failure excerpt.
The retry path uses the same code path with no conditional branch in the loop.
A blocked outcome ends the run without consuming an attempt.
Attempt exhaustion escalates the task and ends the run as blocked.
Each termination reason maps to its documented distinct exit code.
Every prompt is persisted to disk before its dispatch is attempted.
Two consecutive unparseable results end the run as a runner error.

nodes.title: Implement: orchestrator.py — the continuous execution loop
Write failing tests: cli.py — full command surface

acceptance_criteria.statement: Initialisation refuses to run outside a git repository or over existing state.
The run command refuses to start on an unapproved draft plan.
A dry run composes and prints every prompt while dispatching none.
Rebuild detects a divergent projection and fails loudly without repairing it.
Status exit codes distinguish ready, all terminal, and escalated states.
Log output contains no credential value under any input.

nodes.note: SELF-HOSTING CROSSOVER. On completion of T-0033 redgear can execute its own remaining tasks. Everything up to here is driven manually.

nodes.title: Implement: cli.py — full command surface
Write failing tests: runner.py — Claude Code headless adapter

acceptance_criteria.statement: Argument vectors are built as lists with the prompt as a discrete element.
Tool permission strings are generated from scope with correct prefix spacing.
No configuration path can produce a permission-skipping flag.
A failure payload delivered on standard output with a zero exit code is detected.
Parsing never asserts a specific nonzero exit code value.
A missing structured result triggers exactly one reminder retry.
Raw output streams are persisted before parsing is attempted.
The environment is propagated without any credential value being read or logged.

nodes.note: All tests run against recorded fixture payloads. No test invokes the real CLI. Manual integration is a documented procedure, never CI.

nodes.title: Implement: runner.py — Claude Code headless adapter
Write failing tests: planner.py — plan generation with mandatory approval gate

acceptance_criteria.statement: The planning dispatch is granted read-only tools and cannot edit files.
A generated plan is written in draft state and is not executable.
A plan with an implementation task lacking a test source is rejected.
Approval records the approver and the specification hash at that moment.
Editing the specification after approval invalidates it.
Validation failures are returned to the planner up to the retry cap then surfaced.

nodes.title: Implement: planner.py — plan generation with mandatory approval gate
Write failing tests: api/app.py — read-only control plane API

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every response is derived from the event log or a projection rebuilt from it.
No endpoint mutates task state other than a human approval action.
Dispatched prompts are retrievable verbatim per iteration.
Proof artifacts including the raw diff are retrievable per attempt.
No response body contains a credential value.

nodes.title: Implement: api/app.py — read-only control plane API
Control plane user interface

acceptance_criteria.statement: The dashboard builds cleanly and renders the graph, prompts, diffs, and proofs.
The interface issues no request to any endpoint that mutates task state.

nodes.note: SCAFFOLD type: front-end build, verified by build success and manual render check.

nodes.title: Packaging and release readiness

acceptance_criteria.statement: The built artifact contains no credential file and its manifest is reviewed.
Secret scanning over full history reports nothing.
Egress grep gates report zero matches across the package.
Isolated installation from the artifact yields a working command on a clean machine.

nodes.note: SCAFFOLD type: release verification, no coverage gate.
